info.name: No Part Routes — Easy Testing
info.description: Open this collection's Variables tab. Set baseUrl and sharedSecret, then choose fromType/toType (label, address, pluscode, or coordinates) and fill in fromValue/toValue. Coordinates use latitude,longitude. Send Route — build JSON from fields; its pre-request script produces properly escaped JSON. Keep baseUrl without a trailing slash. Discovery requests do not call Google. A route request uses your server's Google key; never enter that key here. Routes allow tolls first; if tolls are reported, the server also requests an avoid-tolls route automatically. Both results appear in the response. No extra request variables are needed. Public template only: supplied locations are illustrative and sharedSecret is empty. Keep private service URLs, credentials, personal locations, and saved responses in local exports under another filename; never overwrite this public template with a configured export.

request.description: Fill in the collection Variables tab, then Send. The generated body uses JSON.stringify, so addresses containing quotes are safe. Body shows a variable placeholder; inspect the sent request in Postman's Console to view the final JSON. You can mix origin/destination types. Post-response checks appear in Test Results. Top-level values describe the primary route with tolls allowed. usesTolls reports toll use. If true, avoidTolls contains the second estimate, or avoidTollsError contains its failure code/message while the primary route still succeeds. If false, both are null. Avoiding tolls is a preference, so the alternative can still report usesTolls=true. Each outbound Routes attempt counts against the daily cap.

item.name: Locations — saved labels (authenticated, no Google call)

request.description: Returns loaded labels and their user-configured values. Use a label in the route builder's fromValue/toValue after setting its type to label. Save locations.ini; the next route or locations request after 0.5 seconds reloads it automatically. Invalid edits retain the last valid labels and log a warning.
